message: Hi Alex, it's Marcus at Luna Hair Studio, quick question before we talk: did an AI write this email?
reply: Hi Marcus, honestly — yes, I use AI to help draft and speed up outreach, but I review and send everything myself. Same for the audits I run: AI-assisted, human-checked. I'm upfront about that because I'd rather earn trust than fake it. Happy to show you the actual issues I found on your site if you want to chat. - Alex
